decision: F-1.4: chapter_slot_count and project_cst_schedule resolve the CST's published breakdown INTERNALLY (no signature change) and union its exam+holiday dates into the holiday set; None breakdown -> empty sets (graceful, D-3). Keeps all call sites (list_class_path + 3 projector callers) unchanged. projector uses a private _resolve_published_breakdown_id inline-query + lazy import of the chapter_calendar getters to avoid a chapter_calendar<->projector and chapter_plan_service<->projector import cycle.
rationale: Plan said 'thread it through'; internal resolution achieves the same exclusion with zero call-site churn and avoids import cycles.

decision: F-1.3/D-4: did NOT add a separate exam_overlap advisory warning type. A chapter inside an exam/holiday window surfaces via the existing zero_teaching_days warning once exam+holiday dates feed compute_range_warnings.
rationale: D-4 left exam_overlap optional and defaulted to relying on zero_teaching_days.
